name: csv_stats
description: Per-column statistics of a CSV, like csvkit's csvstat: inferred type (integer, decimal, boolean, date, datetime, text), nulls, distinct values, top values, min, max, sum, mean, median, sample variance and standard deviation, decimal places and text lengths. The dialect is sniffed (comma, semicolon, tab, pipe) or given; numbers are summed exactly and printed as decimal strings. CSV inline or a relative file.

path.description: Or a relative path to a CSV file

delimiter.description: Override the sniffed delimiter; \t for tab

null_values.description: Default: empty, NA, N/A, null, NULL, None, nan, NaN, -

precision.description: Significant digits of mean, variance and stdev

catalog.source: Behaviour of csvkit's csvstat (wireservice/csvkit, type inference after agate); Python csv.Sniffer for the dialect
